sources: https://concordiaks.org/departments/parks___recreation/parks/camping_-_airport_park.php (City of Concordia), read 2026-11-05: 'Airport Park Campground is conveniently located adjacent to US-81 Highway, on the south side of Concordia. The campground is a first come, first served basis and a fee-by-donation campsite for a stay up to 7 days. Four spots are designated as long term camping and can be reserved for up to 8 weeks. A permit is required which can be obtained at City Hall, along with payment of $150 per week. Longer term stays are a possibility with City Clerk approval. Utilities are available all year round and open to guests 24 hours a day. The scenic & wooded camping area includes 10 drive-through pads and 4 back-in pads with water and electric hookups. A dump station is onsite. Several other pads are available without utility hookups, and the site is ideal for tents. Restroom facilities are available. ... *Tent Campers are allowed up to three nights of stay per City Ordinance 15-203*'; City Hall 785-243-2670

note: City of Concordia park beside US-81 on the south side of town, next to Blosser Municipal Airport (wooded loop; Walmart and two restaurants across the highway). 14 concrete hookup pads (sites 1-14), plus pads without hookups; restrooms, picnic and storm shelters, playground, disc golf course and dog park. --Claude
summary: City page and campsite map confirm FCFS, donation, 7-day max, 50/30/20-amp electric + water on 14 pads (10 drive-through), dump, utilities year-round. Fees left (donation, no rate). Waterfront not waterfront kept; pin fine. Four of 14 pads are long-term permit spots: not long-stay in character.
flags: FEES: none written. The city says 'fee-by-donation'. Nothing in fees today; a $0 base would be wrong for a suggested donation, so I left it absent.

LONG-STAY (passes): 4 of the 14 hookup pads are long-term permit spots (up to 8 weeks, $150/week, longer with clerk approval); the other 10 are nightly FCFS with a 7-day max. A transient campground with a long-term corner, not long-stay in character. Google 4.6 from 187.

SITES: the map labels pad lengths 18' to 69', and 10 pads are drive-through, so a 23-ft rig fits. I didn't write max_rig_ft from pad lengths. Total count not written: the page gives 14 hookup pads plus 'several other pads'.
The note said '12 concrete pads'; the city says 14 (10 drive-through + 4 back-in), and its map numbers 1-14. Corrected.

PIN fine: 39.5485,-97.6553 is inside the campground loop. PHONE 785-243-2670 matches. WEBSITE https://concordiaks.org/departments/parks___recreation/parks/camping_-_airport_park.php is live and correct. WATERFRONT not waterfront kept (a small drainage pond lies south of the park, outside the campground). SAND: none.
